title: Conversion to an E3SAT tester
statement: Every OXR sign tester on $n$ coordinates determines a sign tester whose seeds are pairs consisting of an original seed and a uniformly random sign. The seed distribution first samples the original seed and then the sign; the check uses the E3SAT sign clause formed from the falsifying sign tuple specified by the original seed's negations and the sampled sign, together with that original seed's three queries.
caveat: The supplied definitions do not specify the construction of the E3SAT sign clause, so its exact clause semantics cannot be rendered.
